signal: BlinkOps raised a $50M Series B, crossed $100M total raised, and made Fortune's 2026 Cyber 60 list for a second year

email.body1:
Brian, saw BlinkOps closed a $50M Series B, crossed $100M raised, and made the Fortune Cyber 60 again.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise security accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for BlinkOps off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brian, quick follow-up for BlinkOps.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BlinkOps needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brian, last bit of proof for BlinkOps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BlinkOps's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B security startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brian, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B security motion? I will tailor it to BlinkOps either way.
